title: New Here
note: Permanent. Runs every week, first. Only change it when Ben asks.
bullets: If this is your first time with us, we're really glad you're here, and there's no pressure to do anything this morning except settle in.
When you get a chance, scan or tap the QR code in front of you and tell us a little about yourself; it only takes a minute.
As a thank you, we'll give $10 to a local charity in your honor, and our team will pray for you by name this week.
